prompt:
A single vertical Twitch channel "About" panel graphic, full bleed, for a fantasy MMO and anime RPG gaming channel. Look: premium game UI like a high-end modern anime action RPG or MMO menu, painterly and richly detailed, NOT flat vector. Mood: a cozy adventurers' guild tavern — warm, welcoming and lively, like "come in, sit down, we are about to start". Warm lantern and hearth light, polished dark wood, brass fittings, leather, maps. NOT gloomy, NOT gothic, NOT horror, no skulls, no darkness-heavy shadows. Frame: carved warm walnut wood with polished brass/gold corner fittings and small amber gems around the whole panel. Inside: a rich warm dark-brown wood or leather background (#2a1a10 to #1a100a) softly lit in amber, so light text stays very readable. Palette: honey gold (#f5c542), warm amber, candle orange, wine red accents, warm browns; a small touch of teal for contrast. Mature anime RPG art, not cute, not chibi, not cartoonish, not childish, no stickers. TYPOGRAPHY IS CRITICAL: render every text string EXACTLY as written below, in Spanish, letter by letter, with its accents, punctuation and the leading exclamation mark on commands. Crisp, perfectly legible, evenly spaced. Do not add, translate, abbreviate or invent any other text, numbers, logos or watermarks.

HEADER (only the top ~15% of the panel, a short wide strip): a painted scene of the tavern's guild counter — a warm hearth, hanging lanterns, a wooden quest board with blank pinned parchments (no writing on them), two crossed swords mounted on the wall above, a frothy mug on the counter; it blends softly into the panel. Right under the header, centered: the title "COMANDOS" in a large carved gold serif (Cinzel-like) with a soft warm glow, and under it a smaller cream line "Escríbelos en el chat". Then a small ornamental divider with the section label "LOOT" in gold small caps. Then a two-column list of 14 entries, 7 rows. Each entry is a glossy gold plaque with dark bold monospace text for the command, and directly under it a short description in bright cream-white bold sans-serif. TEXT SIZE: this panel is shown shrunk to 320 px wide, so all text must be LARGE: command text about 42 px tall and description text about 36 px tall in this 1024 px wide image, filling most of each column width. Use the vertical space for text, not for decoration. Rows read left then right: Row 1: "!loot" / "Cómo funciona" — "!pj" / "Tu ficha de personaje". Row 2: "!inventario" / "Tu mochila" — "!top" / "Podio del mes". Row 3: "!temporada" / "Tus puntos y premios" — "!evento" / "Evento de la semana". Row 4: "!duelo nombre" / "Reta a alguien" — "!dar ana 2" / "Regala un objeto". Row 5: "!usar" / "Usa un objeto mágico" — "!atacar" / "Pega al jefe". Row 6: "!forjar" / "3 iguales → 1 mejor" — "!presumir" / "Tu mejor pieza en pantalla". Row 7: "!coleccion" / "Colección y títulos" — "!purificar" / "Limpia un maldito (Poción)". Then, with clear space above and below it (as much as between the title and "LOOT"), another ornamental divider with the section label "CON EL BOT". Then one row of 2 entries: "!pregunta" / "Pregúntale a la IA" — "!incomoda" / "Pregunta incómoda (subs)". Leave comfortable margins inside the frame; nothing touches the frame. Thin faint separators between rows.
